title: Formal, Executable and Explainable Runtime Monitoring of Spoken Air Traffic Control Operational Procedures
abstract: arXiv:2608.25926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Air traffic control procedures are executed through spoken exchanges between controllers and pilots. These interactions are essential to the safety of air transportation: failures in their execution can create severe operational hazards, as evidenced by past fatal accidents. Assessing whether an instruction has been followed requires relating what was said to the aircraft concerned, its state, and the obligations that pilots must meet. We present a runtime verification framework that monitors such procedures by checking controller-pilot exchanges, surveillance data, and onboard observations. The framework parses radio communications into events linked to the entities they concern and merges them with surveillance and onboard observations into a time-stamped trace. translated_title: 形式化、可执行且可解释的空中交通管制口语运行程序运行时监控
translated_abstract: 空中交通管制程序通过管制员与飞行员之间的口语交流来执行。这些交互对航空运输安全至关重要：其执行中的失误可能造成严重的运行危险，过去的致命事故已证明了这一点。评估一项指令是否被遵循，需要将所说内容与相关飞机、其状态以及飞行员必须履行的义务联系起来。我们提出了一种运行时验证框架，通过检查管制员-飞行员交流、监视数据和机载观测来监控此类程序。该框架将无线电通信解析为与相关实体关联的事件，并将其与监视和机载观测合并为带时间戳的轨迹。源自国际民航组织的义务被形式化为具有显式时间界限的时序公式，并在执行轨迹上进行评估。每个违规行为都会连同其违反的具体公式一起报告。
tldr: 本文提出了一种运行时验证框架，通过将口语无线电通信与监视和机载数据融合，并采用带时间界限的时序公式形式化国际民航组织义务，实现对空中交通管制程序的可执行且可解释的实时监控。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a runtime verification framework that fuses spoken radio communications with surveillance and onboard data, formalizing ICAO obligations as temporal formulas with explicit time bounds to enable executable and explainable real-time monitoring of air traffic control procedures.
